name: Wellenviertel
style: Bright pastel blues and sandy beiges dominate, with curved, wave‑shaped houses, light timber frames, whitewashed walls, and a breezy, relaxed seaside mood.

blossom-tree.name: Kirschbaum
variations: tall cherry tree with pastel pink blossoms swaying over a wave‑shaped roof
slender cherry tree with white blossoms and a wind‑swept canopy
small cherry sapling in a sand‑filled pot, branches curling like waves

green-tree.name: Olivenbaum
variations: slim olive tree with silvery leaves, trunk curved like a sea wave
short olive tree with twisted trunk and a few ripe olives
young olive tree in a wooden planter, leaves rustling in a breezy pose

lamp.name: Laterne
variations: curved metal street lamp with a pastel‑blue glass shade, gentle wave motif on the pole
simple white‑washed lantern with a rope‑like cord, hanging from a low post
tall pastel‑green lamp post with a wave‑shaped iron base and a soft glowing bulb

bush.name: Buchsbaum
variations: low evergreen shrub trimmed into a smooth dome, dotted with tiny white flowers
weathered wooden crate stacked with seashells and driftwood, placed between houses
small barrel painted beige, half‑filled with sand and a sprig of sea lavender

lawn.name: Rasenfläche

thin, parallel lines that ripple like a calm sea: base colour #BCE7A5, the shapes in slightly lighter and darker shades of the base colour

rounded cobblestones arranged in concentric circles: base colour #E0E0E0, the shapes in slightly lighter and darker shades of the base colour
long, narrow rectangles laid out in a flowing, sinusoidal line: base colour #E0E0E0, the shapes in slightly lighter and darker shades of the base colour

shop.name: Laden
variations: small fishmonger stall with nets and hanging lanterns

variations: a white seagull standing, seen from the front, yellow beak

a red crab standing on its legs, claws raised, seen from the front
a pelican standing, big yellow beak, seen from the front

landmark.name: Leuchtturm
landmark.idea: A pastel lighthouse with pink and white bands that narrows towards the top, with a gallery, a glowing lantern room and a domed cap, standing on an eight-sided pier.
